result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the horizontal restaurant carousel under 'Fastest near you' clips the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right edge with truncated title text and no visible scroll affordance, which reads as visually broken. The '-0%' discount badge on the second popular card is also a content/logic oddity.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal row ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge, with its title truncated mid-word and no visible scroll indicator or peek padding to signal that the row is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding or a partial-card peek with a scroll hint (e.g., gradient fade or chevron) so users understand the row scrolls horizontally, and ensure card titles ellipsize gracefully rather than clipping at the viewport edge.

issues.description: The discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card shows '-0%', which is a meaningless discount value and looks like a data/logic error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount is 0%, or only render it when a real promotion exists.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', ...) is also clipped at the right edge with a partially visible chip and no scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade or ensure the last visible chip is fully shown to indicate horizontal scrollability.
